related_resources.reason: Primary Sanskrit narrative: birth, Ayodhya succession, exile, and Sita’s abduction.
Modern translation and critical historical framing.
Differences across retellings, including later protective-line traditions.

creators.name: Valmiki
creators.note: Traditional attribution of a layered and transmitted text; not proof of a single historical author.

description: Introduces Rama and Sita, the broken succession at Ayodhya, exile in the forest and Sita’s abduction, exploring duty, family promises and the Ramayana’s long textual and religious life.
